topics.description: The investigation into the fatal shooting of Renee Good by ICE officers is ongoing, with the Minneapolis mayor urging the FBI to include state officials in the inquiry. This topic is trending due to the high level of public interest and concern over the use of force by law enforcement.

The investigation into welfare fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal, is ongoing. This topic is trending due to the large amount of money involved and the potential for widespread corruption.
